distribution: Local operator installation only; proprietary application artifacts are fetched from their publishers, not redistributed by this repository.

gui-kitty.provenance: Official upstream Linux amd64 bundle; SHA256 published in GitHub release assets and independently read back from downloaded bytes.
gui-kitty.runtime_alias_reason: Actual bundled _sqlite3.so DT_NEEDED is unversioned libsqlite3.so; the official archive ships only lib/libsqlite3.so.0. Supply an internal alias to those exact bundled bytes, not a system development package or global loader override.

gui-tabiew.provenance: Official stable x86_64 musl executable; SHA256 published in GitHub release assets. The command is tw, not tabiew.

gui-slack.provenance: Official Slack Debian package, matching SHA256 in the vendor Packages index; Noble contains every declared ABI dependency. Only the repository-enabling cron script is removed in the local repack, keeping all runtime bytes/notices unchanged.
gui-slack.license: Proprietary Slack terms; bundled third-party notices retained

gui-capacities.provenance: Official current Linux .deb, verified against latest-linux.yml SHA512 and independently hashed SHA256. Chosen instead of AppImage: vendor Noble AppArmor/user-namespace integration and native desktop entry; no FUSE, extraction-at-launch or NixGL.
gui-capacities.license: Proprietary Capacities terms; LICENSE.electron.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html retained

gui-chromium.name: chromium
gui-chromium.provenance: Canonical verified publisher, official Snap Store v2 channel-map; immutable revision bytes independently hashed. Build also retrieves the complete assertion chain with snap download; provision requires snap ack against snapd trust roots, never --dangerous or --devmode.
gui-chromium.runtime_dependencies: Read from the verified snap meta/snap.yaml at build; snapd resolves base and content default-providers from signed store assertions. Dependencies remain snapd-owned shared OS runtimes and are never removed by this recipe.
gui-chromium.daemon_owner: Ubuntu Noble snapd APT package owns system unit bytes and /var/lib/snapd. Repository existing-unit service snapd-socket owns explicit privileged activation via bootstrap services enable/start --id snapd-socket --yes; recipe requires it ready and never starts/enables/stops shared OS services.
gui-chromium.refresh_owner: This recipe installs the exact reviewed asserted local artifact or refreshes the exact reviewed store revision, then holds only chromium automatic refresh forever. Explicit future provision is the update operation; base/content snaps retain Canonical security refresh ownership.
gui-chromium.retirement: Disable only this owned application and keep its refresh hold. Do not snap remove: it removes live profile data and expires automatic snapshots. Preserve installed revision, /var/snap, ~/snap, profile migrations and shared daemon/dependencies for recovery.

interfaces.chromium-config: Explicit snap connect permits publisher first-launch read-only import of ~/.config/chromium; original profile is never removed or recorded as owned.
interfaces.password-manager-service: Explicit snap connect is required before acceptance, preventing the publisher launcher selecting password-store=basic. Native keyring/import qualification remains a physical-host gate.

gui-chromium.license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND LGPL-2.0 AND LGPL-2.1 AND MIT AND MS-PL AND (GPL-2.0+ OR LGPL-2.1+ OR MPL-1.1)
gui-chromium.physical_host_gate: Chromium sandbox/AppArmor, graphics, portals, keyring, existing-profile migration and desktop launch must be qualified on the actual Noble workstation before legacy browser retirement. No container result closes this gate.
